problem.title: Managing freight through calls and messengers costs too much
problem.subtitle: Documented studies and industry realities in Uzbekistan's logistics market:
problem.macroContext: Uzbekistan's foreign trade turnover grew from $50B (2022) to $81.2B (2025) — cargo volume is soaring, yet operations remain heavily manual.
problem.beforeAfterTitle: The difference between everyday chaos and unified control
problem.before1: Constant calls: “Where is the driver?”, “Unloaded or still waiting?”
problem.before2: Scattered across dozens of noisy Telegram groups with drivers and customers
problem.before3: Empty return trips — every unladen kilometer is a direct financial loss
problem.before4: Zero unified data on fuel costs, driver delays, or true trip margin
problem.after1: Every driver, truck, and order status visible on a single dispatcher board
problem.after2: Drivers snap signed waybills directly into a Telegram bot; clients get instant confirmation
problem.after3: Systematic backhaul matching to turn empty return trips into revenue
problem.after4: Clear automated reporting on punctuality, trip expenses, and driver efficiency
problem.macroGrowthNote: calculated based on source data: +62% growth

howItWorks.title: Full control in three simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No heavy software installations or steep learning curves. Dispatchers use a clean web board; drivers stay in familiar Telegram.
howItWorks.step1Desc: The dispatcher enters trip details, address, and deadline in the web panel or confirms a customer request.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Drivers receive shipment briefs directly in their personal Telegram bot. Both dispatchers and clients follow real-time progress on the map.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Upon handover, the driver submits a signed bill of lading photo or signature via the bot. All parties receive instant verified confirmation.

features.title: Engineered for the real needs of small and mid-size fleets
features.subtitle: Practical, focused tools designed to simplify your everyday dispatching operations:
features.f1Desc: Centralize all ongoing shipments, idle vehicles, and assigned trips in one intuitive board with color-coded statuses.
features.f2Desc: Monitor real-time transit speeds, stationary idle times, and estimated times of arrival (ETA) on an interactive map.
features.f3Desc: Drivers snap signed waybills or record digital sign-offs directly inside Telegram, syncing immediately to order files.
features.f4Desc: Match trucks returning empty from regional deliveries with available return cargo to drastically reduce deadhead mileage.
features.f5Desc: Track transit duration, root causes of delays, cost per trip, fuel metrics, and individual driver performance trends.
features.f6Desc: Drivers do not need complex app downloads or training. Operations run seamlessly through their existing Telegram messenger.

backhaul.title: Empty return trips — the hidden drain on fleet profitability
backhaul.subtitle: Delivering cargo to regional hubs and driving back to Tashkent empty burns fuel, truck lifespan, and driver hours for zero revenue. Intelligent backhaul matching aims to turn those deadhead miles into profit.
backhaul.outboundDesc: Full commercial payload from Tashkent to Samarkand (100% capacity utilization).
backhaul.emptyReturnDesc: Unladen return journey: fuel and vehicle depreciation erode trip profit margins.
backhaul.matchedReturnDesc: Intelligent matching with return cargo batches — targeting revenue on every traveled kilometer.
backhaul.traditionalReturnDrawback: Fuel and maintenance costs yield no revenue

faq.title: Answers to common questions
faq.subtitle: Transparent details regarding security, hardware, pricing, and onboarding:
faq.q1: When will the platform officially launch?
faq.a1: Core system modules are currently in active development. Private beta invitations will be distributed to waitlist members first. You will be among the very first to receive launch milestones and test invites.
faq.q2: Do drivers need to install heavy mobile apps?
faq.a2: No. Our core philosophy is effortless adoption. Drivers interact exclusively via a standard Telegram bot to view assignments, submit signed documents, and update trip milestones.
faq.q3: Will our existing GPS trackers work?
faq.a3: Yes. We are architecting support for standard GPS telematics protocols and popular tracker brands widely used in Uzbekistan. A smartphone-based GPS fallback option is also being developed for trucks without hardware units.
faq.q4: How is our commercial data protected?
faq.a4: We implement multi-layered web security: end-to-end TLS encryption, strict database Row Level Security (RLS), Cloudflare WAF, and zero sharing or selling of your customer or routing data to third parties.
faq.a5: The entire platform fully supports Uzbek (Latin script), Russian, and English. Dispatchers and drivers can each select their preferred language.
faq.q6: What will the pricing model look like?
faq.a6: Final subscription plans are currently being finalized. Early access members will receive an extended free trial period and grandfathered partner discounts. Pricing will scale fairly based on active fleet size.
faq.q7: Will you integrate with 1C or existing accounting software?
faq.a7: Our engineering roadmap includes open REST API connectors for common accounting suites including 1C. During initial rollout, seamless Excel / CSV export and import is supported.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how {brand} collects, uses, and safeguards the contact and fleet details provided through our early access waitlist.
privacy.dataCollectedText: We collect exclusively: your full name, Uzbekistan phone number (+998), company name, operational role, fleet size category, and preferred language.
privacy.purposeText: Information is used strictly to invite eligible transport operators to our closed beta trials, understand fleet requirements, and communicate launch updates.
privacy.retentionText: All waitlist records are stored in a secured Postgres database protected by Row Level Security (RLS) policies. We never sell, rent, or distribute contact information to third parties.
privacy.rightsText: You may request the deletion or correction of your contact details from our waitlist at any time by contacting us through our official support channels.
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy covering waitlist, company portal, and driver portal data protection.
privacy.legalReviewNotice: Legal notice: Drafted with Uzbekistan Law O'RQ-547 (On Personal Data) in mind; should be reviewed by qualified legal counsel before commercial launch.
privacy.portalAccountsText: For company owners, dispatchers, and drivers, we store email, role, name, phone number, company details, and security audit logs. Passport numbers and national IDs are never collected.
privacy.proofPhotosText: Hidden EXIF and GPS metadata are stripped from driver delivery photos on the server before storing them in a private bucket accessed via short-lived signed URLs.
privacy.futureGpsText: Phase 1 does not collect live GPS telemetry. When Phase 2 GPS launches, it will require explicit driver consent and clear in-app indicators.
